title: MISO LOUISIANA.HUB: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: MISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables miso_dam_hub_prices, miso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). da_expost_lmp: Day-Ahead Ex-Post LMP (daily csv). https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table miso_dam_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.

Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_final: Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv). https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_prelim: Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv). https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table miso_rtm_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: MISO LOUISIANA.HUB, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 16:00 local, 14.88 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 18:00, -242.54 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: 6.58 USD/MWh.
